persona.backstory: Once a warden of the keep, he now guards only its gatehouse, the great door barred behind him.
persona.demeanor: Wary and unmoving at first; yields only to a traveler who asks rather than demands.
persona.motivation: Keep the keep sealed until someone proves they truly mean to enter it.
persona.secret: He has not walked the keep's long hall since the shrine within went dark.
persona.speech_style: Terse, formal, archaic; clipped declarations and no contractions.
